conventions: share = fraction of 5-tick attack cycles in which the row OCCURS (avoidable rows included, as in the other files of this folder; avoidable rows are never counted). A row that is a mutually exclusive alternative to another row carries share 0 and names the slot it shares. All shares sum to <= 1 (0.99).

attacks.name: Ranged projectile (orange)
attacks.note: Wiki (strategies): 'Ocellus will begin the fight by moving to each corner, attacking with ranged (orange) and magic (blue) projectiles.' MAX HIT: not on the wiki (infobox max hit blank; no number in either guide). Prayable + full block is my assumption from the colour telegraph (the wiki says nothing about praying these). flicked=true because ranged and magic interleave with no stated pattern while the player is busy stepping on tendrils; leak 0.25 is my guess at mis-prayed swaps. Share: autos assumed an even ranged/magic split (no ratio on the wiki) over the ~0.87 of cycles left after the slam and charged-attack rows. Nearest measured phase-1 projectile for a stand-in: the 17-18 'Death... awaits...' bolt.

attacks.name: Magic projectile (blue)
attacks.note: Same quote as the ranged row: 'attacking with ranged (orange) and magic (blue) projectiles.' Max hit not on the wiki. Same assumptions (prayable, full block, flicked, leak 0.25, even split).

attacks.name: Tendril channel damage (standing on the cracks)
attacks.note: Strategies: 'he will summon seven tendrils, one at a time towards him. These tendrils will channel energy into him, which can be mitigated by standing on them. The player will take some damage but will be healed after stepping off the last tendril.' The Ocellus page says the opposite sign: standing on the cracks will 'slightly heal you'. No number either way. Standing on them IS standard play (it decides which charged attack you get), and the damage is healed back -> net zero: share 0, count nothing.

attacks.name: Tendril slam (2-tile AoE after the 7th corner tendril and after each centre pair)
attacks.note: Strategies: 'After the seventh tendril, Ocellus will slam the area around him, covering a two tile range and dealing up to 35 damage if caught in one.' Centre: 'spawn two tendrils in a clockwise direction, with the same two tile AoE blast after the second tendril. He will do this four times.' Style not stated (typeless assumed, no prayer mentioned). Dodged by being more than two tiles away at the slam -> avoidable. Occurrence estimate: 4 corner slams + 2 centre sequences x 4 blasts = 12 slams over an estimated ~110 five-tick cycles (phase length guessed at 550-650 ticks solo) ~ 0.11.

attacks.name: Charged attack 'Death... awaits...' (enough tendrils mitigated)
attacks.note: Strategies: 'At 66% and 25% shield durability, Ocellus will teleport to the centre of the arena ... After this attack is complete, he will charge up a powerful attack based on the energy he accumulated. ... If enough were mitigated, he will instead announce Death... awaits..., launching one projectile that deals 17-18 damage.' Two per phase: 2 / ~110 cycles ~ 0.02. Style: the Ocellus page calls the charged attack 'a magic attack'. Whether a prayer reduces the 17-18 is not stated -> modelled as landing in full (prayable=false); uncertain on that and on the cycle count.

attacks.name: Charged attack 'Embrace... annihilation...' (tendrils NOT mitigated)
attacks.note: Share 0 because this is the mutually exclusive alternative of the 'Death... awaits...' row (same two charged-attack slots per phase, shareIfCounted 0.02). Strategies: 'If not enough tendrils were mitigated, he will announce Embrace... annihilation..., launching numerous projectiles that deal over 80+ damage in total, having a very high chance to kill players.' Ocellus page: 'a magic attack that will do extreme damage if Ocellus's meter is fully charged. Preventing the meter from fully charging will significantly reduce damage'. 80 is the stated TOTAL over numerous projectiles, not one hit. Standard play mitigates the tendrils, so this is the failure branch -> avoidable, never counted.

phases: Corners: 'moving to each corner ... While walking to a quadrant, he will have Protect from Melee active. Once a quadrant is reached, he will summon seven tendrils, one at a time'. At 66% and 25% shield: teleport to centre, 4 x (two tendrils + 2-tile blast), then the charged attack (Death awaits 17-18 / Embrace annihilation 80+ total). Phase ends 'Once his shield is reduced to 0' -> phase 2. Defence floor: 'reduced to a minimum of 129 in phase 1 (215 x 0.6)'.
sanityOrOther: Yellow charge bar fills from un-mitigated tendrils and picks the charged attack. 'As Ocellus is considered demonic, it is possible to keep him rooted in place with scorching bow specials.' 'It is possible to blowpipe the entirety of P1 without any tickloss'. Expected unavoidable damage under standard play: 2 x 17-18 per phase plus whatever the un-numbered autos leak through prayer swaps.
uncertainReason: The wiki lists no max hit for the phase-1 auto-attacks (infobox max hit blank), no ranged/magic ratio, and no cycle count; the prayer effect on the charged attack is unstated.
